note: A contract says what a kind of screen may hold. A page model (e.g. rawdah-landing.json) is one page built to a contract. Read the index, pick by job, then read the one contract.

templates.name: Service landing
templates.job: The front page of a service that offers a catalogue. It lets a person find an item by search, by category or by theme.
templates.useFor: A service that sells a catalogue with several categories, when the person arrives from Home services, the Market tab or a deep link without an item in mind, and needs search, categories and curated rows on one page.
templates.notFor: A service with one item or one flow (start at item details or the first step of that flow); a person who already picked a category or typed a query (use Market category or Search results); a person in a sacred window, where the service is suppressed and this page is never linked from a ritual screen; content that is not for sale, such as articles or guides, which belong to a content landing.

templates.name: Catalogue list
templates.job: Every item of one category, as a grid or a list, with the running selection always in reach.
templates.useFor: One flat list of one kind of item — the items of a category, a collection or a brand — reached from the landing or a themed row’s arrow, for comparing by photo and price (grid) or by longer names and detail (list).
templates.notFor: A typed query (use Search results, which adds the query, the filters and a no-results state); a list that mixes kinds such as items with articles or services (use a landing with rows); a category that would hold only 1 or 2 items (show them in a landing row instead of a near-empty page); a person in a sacred window, where the page is suppressed with the rest of the service.

templates.name: Item details
templates.job: Everything needed to decide on one item: media, name and provider, description, options, then one action that adds or books it.
templates.useFor: One item that needs more than its card can hold — several photos, a description, options such as size or colour — opened from a card, a search result, a notification or a shared link, going into a cart to be paid for later with other items.
templates.notFor: A booking with a date, a slot or a permit (use the booking flow, where availability and holds follow other rules); an item with no options and nothing more to say than its card (let the card add it directly); an item with a flow of its own, such as an add-on task (start that flow instead); a person in a sacred window, where the page is suppressed with the rest of the service.

templates.name: Cart
templates.job: Review what was chosen, where it goes and what it costs, then move to payment.
templates.useFor: The step between choosing items and paying for them.
templates.notFor: A single-item purchase with its own flow, or a booking.

templates.name: Payment
templates.job: Pay with nothing else on the page.
templates.useFor: Paying for a cart or a booking.
templates.notFor: Showing an invoice (use the cost breakdown sheet) or confirming a free request.

templates.name: Request tracking
templates.job: Where a request is now, what happens next, and how to get help.
templates.useFor: One request after payment: in progress, fulfilled or cancelled.
templates.notFor: The list of all requests (use Requests list).

templates.name: Requests list
templates.job: Every request of the person in one service, current and past.
templates.useFor: Finding a request and opening its tracking page.
templates.notFor: Today or a landing: there, use upcoming-requests with the next requests only.

templates.name: Search in a service
templates.job: Find an item by name inside a service.
templates.useFor: A person who knows what they want.
templates.notFor: Browsing with no query (use the landing).

templates.name: Help and support
templates.job: Answers and a way to reach a person, from inside a service.
templates.useFor: Help with a request or with the service.
templates.notFor: Marketing content or FAQs that sell.

templates.name: Address selection
templates.job: Choose a saved place or add a new one.
templates.useFor: Selecting or adding an address during a transaction.
templates.notFor: Managing the profile address book.

templates.name: Cancellation
templates.job: Cancel a request with a clear reason and a clear refund.
templates.useFor: Cancelling a paid request that can still be cancelled.
templates.notFor: Returns after fulfilment, or removing an item from a cart.

templates.name: Add-on task
templates.job: Choose an optional extra, personalise it and add it to the request.
templates.useFor: Adding one optional, personalised extra to a request.
templates.notFor: An extra that is a service of its own.

templates.name: Cost breakdown sheet
templates.job: The amounts of one request, readable in a glance.
templates.useFor: Showing the amounts of a paid request.
templates.notFor: Paying (use Payment) or tracking (use Request tracking).

templates.name: Media viewer
templates.job: Look closely at the media of one item.
templates.useFor: Zooming into the media of an item.
templates.notFor: Content galleries or live streams.

templates.name: Date and time · day and period
templates.job: Choose a day and a broad part of the day, for a service where the booking is valid all day. One step of a booking; nothing else from the booking lives here.
templates.useFor: A service where the person commits to a day and a broad arrival window.
templates.notFor: Exact timed entry (use Date and time · day and exact slot). Stay or travel dates (range pickers).

templates.name: Date and time · day and exact slot
templates.job: Choose a day, a part of the day and an exact time, with optional groups of times by audience. One step of a booking; nothing else from the booking lives here.
templates.useFor: Timed entry with limited capacity per slot, with or without separate groups.
templates.notFor: Day-level bookings (use Date and time · day and period). Prayer times display (PrayCard on Today).

templates.name: Booking details
templates.job: One booking after it is made: when it is, where it stands now, who it covers and how to open each pass. The same page serves the booking through its whole life; the state changes the content, not the layout.
templates.useFor: Any single booking, permit or reservation with a time and one or more people.
templates.notFor: A package made of several bookings (use Booking details · package). The step that creates the booking.

templates.name: Booking details · package
templates.job: A booking made of several parts with one provider: where the whole stands, who is in it, what is confirmed, what is still asked of the person, and the money.
templates.useFor: Packages and journeys with several people, several parts and invoices.
templates.notFor: A single visit or permit (use Booking details).

templates.name: Pass sheet
templates.job: The pass of one person, opened over the booking: whether it is valid, whose it is, and the code to show at the gate.
templates.useFor: Any pass, permit or ticket shown to a person or a scanner.
templates.notFor: A pass that is itself a full card with photo (use Pass viewer).

templates.name: Pass viewer
templates.job: A pass that is an identity card: shown full screen, on its own, for inspection.
templates.useFor: Official cards with photo that are inspected by a person as well as scanned.
templates.notFor: Simple code passes (use Pass sheet).
